The [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Malorum]] owned a '''private [[Starship/Legends|starship]]'''. He used this ship to get to and investigate [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]] after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his [[Agent/Legends|agent]] and fellow Inquisitor [[Sancor]], who he had sent to investigate the death of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] so that Malorum may take [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]'s position as [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]'s right hand. Once Malorum finished his investigations and found only facts that were unrelated and nothing winded up conclusive, he looked back to the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|senator's funeral]] and finding it unusual just how quickly it had been organized considering it was the ceremonial [[Naboo (people)/Legends|people]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] who had organized it, alongside the rumors of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] bringing Amidala's body to Naboo for the [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]]. Malorum then left Polis Massa in his starship and set course for Naboo.<ref name="Death on Naboo" />
